L3·N4406unmasked layer
This neuron is essentially a repetition/induction detector with inverted sign: it is strongly *suppressed* on tokens that repeat a word already seen earlier in the passage (e.g. "seminar" after "sales seminar", "Consum(ables)" after "consumables", "Cor(set)" after "corsets", "Ret(ired)" after "retirees"), while its positive activations occur on ordinary, novel content tokens/newlines in miscellaneous web text with no such prior occurrence.
